notes: rust-stdlib-crypto over RustCrypto hmac (SimpleHmac, so SHA-3 works too). New takes a constructor of any hash of this crate (sha256::new, a closure returning crypto::Hash::new, ...) and returns an error for other hash.Hash implementations, which RustCrypto cannot key without knowing the algorithm. Equal runs on the subtle crate.

New.note: Only this crate's hashes are accepted; other hash.Hash implementations return UnsupportedHashError, because HMAC is provided by the reviewed hmac crate and the project does not build MAC constructions itself (ADR 0003).
